scope: Additional anonymous, read-only inspection of public Airscope author Drive code folders, pinned GitHub source, Figshare metadata, and supplement. No authentication, private API, author contact, code change, or dataset payload download.
direct_public_observations: The author Drive Neuron_BERT/datasets page shows five source/notebook files: __init__.py, data_set_vis.ipynb, dataset_augment.py, dataset.py, split_dataset.py. It shows no data_aligned.pkl or experiment-specific label file in that folder.

The author Drive Neuron_BERT/cache page shows val_data_seed_42_pca.pkl. GitHub's pinned tree lists the same file at 7,279,875 bytes (blob 267eab64632ae8249753f0f8471cb5ebb00f82f7). This corrects the earlier overbroad impression that no public social-competition label-bearing artifact exists.

The pinned validate_dual_stream.ipynb passes None as input data to CalciumDataset_two_stream_pair_pca and names val_data_seed_42_pca.pkl as its validation cache; it evaluates a published best_model.pth using binary F1. The dataset class source expects cache keys processed_trials and win_labels. The cache content was not opened, so its actual sample count, labels, and provenance remain unverified.

The author Drive Data_release page shows only experiments, MCU_timestamp, optical_characteristic, and README files; experiments shows enriched_habitat and muiti_animal_interaction. The Checkpoint page shows CorrectionMap.npz, background_rejection_ckpt_resize_2.pth, vessel_model.pt, and yolo_v8s.pt, with no target experiment data file listed.

The public raw_recordings page displays frames.zip only. A HEAD request to the Figshare mirror for that frames.zip returned 302 followed by 403 at the file store; no range request or alternate route was attempted after denial.

Figshare data article 33942097 v1 lists 28 files, with no explicitly named social competition trial data_aligned.pkl or FST/TST paired neural data and labels. Figshare toolbox article 33942148 v1 lists Airscope_toolbox.zip plus four model/calibration artifacts, not a separately named dataset.

The supplement reports FST three-phase AUC and TST binary accuracy, but the inspected public text does not define FST ROC versus PR AUC or its multiclass aggregation, nor provide machine-readable aligned examples or labels.

source_vs_inference.source: The named validation cache, code, and notebook are genuinely public in the author release. The GitHub tree and public Drive page both expose the cache filename; the notebook identifies its intended validation use.
source_vs_inference.inference: The cache likely contains processed social-competition validation features and winner labels because the notebook constructs a dataset from it and the class expects processed_trials and win_labels. This is inferred from code paths, not verified by reading the pickle payload.
source_vs_inference.limit: A public validation cache used with a published checkpoint is not evidence of an independent hidden test set. It lacks verified raw-trial lineage and split separation, so it cannot by itself establish a defensible private benchmark. Absence from the visible public listings is not proof that data do not exist elsewhere; pages may paginate or omit items.

task_readiness.social_competition_trial_binary_f1: Public validation-demo candidate exists via the 7.28 MB cache, but independent benchmark readiness is unverified. Need inspect cache structure and provenance under a separately authorized bounded payload check, and obtain an independent held-out trial release if private scoring is intended.
task_readiness.forced_swim_auc: Not implementable from located public sources: no paired machine-readable examples/phase labels or exact AUC definition.
task_readiness.tail_suspension_accuracy: Not implementable from located public sources: no paired machine-readable examples/active-passive labels.

most_actionable_next_step: Treat the published social-competition cache as a possible public validation example only. Before promoting any Airscope task, verify cache lineage and independence; for FST and TST, require a first-party public paired data/label manifest, and for FST the exact AUC computation. Without those, keep all three out of independent scored Test.
